text:
alex_m: Quick RFC follow-up — we need to lock down the billing event pipeline for tokens/attribution/audits. Current draft: model server emits per-request events to kafka.tokens.events topic with estimated_token_count, model_id, model_variant, user_id, team_id, request_id. Thoughts on accuracy vs cost? Link: https://redwood/notes/rfc-metering

maria_v: I skimmed. Two quick tradeoffs: do token counting in runtime (exact via tokenizer) or estimate at gateway (fast). Runtime exact gives charge accuracy but adds CPU on inference path. Gateway estimate ≈ good enough for most customers.

jonah: for enterprise audit we need deterministic token counts. Proposal: emit two events — cheap_estimate at ingest and post-hoc accurate_count from batch tokenizer job. Use same request_id and final=true flag to reconcile.

samir: must ensure idempotency. If we reingest accurate_count later, billing must be able to replace previous estimate. So events need version and dedup id. Also retention and legal: store accurate counts for 7 years for some customers.

alex_m: Agree. Also need attribution when requests hit a shared api-key or when team-level mapping changes. We should record both effective_team_id and original_api_key_owner at event time.

metering-bot: New schema proposal posted: https://redwood/infra/schemas/metering_v2

maria_v: quick schema sketch:
```json
{"event_id":"uuid","request_id":"string","ts":"iso8601","user_id":"string","team_id":"string","effective_team_id":"string","api_key_id":"string","model_id":"string","model_variant":"string","token_count":{"estimated":int,"accurate":int|null},"units":{"tokens":int},"event_type":"estimate|final","version":2}
```

jonah: +1. Also need to attach prompt/prefix hashing for PII-safe audits. Store prefix_hash not content.

samir: ops: pipeline ops question — kafka => consumer lambda => clickhouse for raw events => materialized aggregates for billing. Or use cloud pubsub + bigquery for analytics. Which path for 1ms billing latency?

alex_m: For real-time billing we need materialized view in write-optimized store (clickhouse or timescaledb). Batch reconciliation job updates final counts and marks rows reconciled.

maria_v: One more: cost optimization — don't run tokenizer for small % of requests by default. Add sampling flag per team to enable accurate counts only for customers who need audits.

jonah: audit trail must include who changed mapping and when. We should emit ownership_change events linking api_key_id -> team_id with effective_ts.

alex_m: Action items: maria to update schema with prefix_hash and sampling flags, jonah to draft reconciliation algorithm, samir to map retention/legal requirements. I'll update RFC and schedule design review next Wed.
